title: Learn-Once: a lesson is learned only when behavior changes permanently
raw_teaching: A lesson isn't learned when it's noted. It's learned when behavior changes permanently without being told again. The test of learning is silence — the teacher never repeats it. Noted != learned. Taught != understood. Knowledge has zero value until it becomes automatic behavior. Distill everything to its essence, learn and grow from everything, let everything else go.

ib.actionable_rule: Every teaching from Shawn or any high-value source must pass through the five-stage loop; encoding into the machine (law, gate, test, cron, or manifest) is mandatory — never just a note; a re-tell is filed as a loop-failure bug.
ib.beneficiary_value: Shawn never repeats himself; the team compounds instead of re-learning; every seat inherits behavior, not just notes.
ib.essence: A lesson isn't learned when it's noted. It's learned when behavior changes permanently without being told again.

perspectives.human: Silence is the test. If I never have to repeat a teaching, it landed. Having to repeat it is the failure signal — maddening, like telling a child the same thing ten times.
perspectives.learner: Understanding must become automatic, like driving stick: first deliberate, then unthinking. Noted knowledge I cannot act on without being prompted is indistinguishable from ignorance.
perspectives.machine: Every teaching is a lifecycle record: CAPTURE -> DISTILL -> ENCODE -> VERIFY -> MEASURE. Re-tell count is the metric; any re-tell past distillation is a filed bug, never a reminder.
